through: Gameweek 6 (last finished gameweek; GW7 had started on 2026-10-17 with 0 of 10 fixtures finished, so excluded)
scoring: Official FPL points. season = FPL points_per_game from bootstrap-static; recent = average FPL points over appearances in GW3-6 (element-summary history).
notes: Coverage: the 267 players with at least 180 minutes this season (of 667 in the FPL pool), sorted by season average.
role is 'steady' for every player: it was not derived from minutes data, so rotation/fringe/rising risk is not reflected. Use minutes or starts if the app should rate it later.
health is mapped only from FPL status, chance_of_playing_next_round and news; short vs long for out players is a default unless news keywords (month, season, ACL, surgery) say otherwise.
Teams use FPL 3-letter short names. name is FPL web_name (not unique across clubs).
recent averages over appearances (minutes>0), not over all gameweeks, so a player who missed a GW is not penalised with a zero; double gameweeks would count each match.
